title: A surjective flat morphism of schemes is an epimorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a surjective flat morphism is an epimorphism in the category of schemes (statement lines 8699-8703). To prove that two morphisms out of the target agreeing after composition with the given morphism are equal, the proof first uses surjectivity to conclude that they agree on underlying topological spaces, which reduces the problem to comparing two maps of local rings at corresponding points (proof lines 8706-8710). At a chosen point it observes that the two maps of local rings become equal after composition with the induced flat local homomorphism of local rings, and that a flat local homomorphism is faithfully flat hence injective, so the two maps coincide (proof lines 8710-8719). Equality of the two morphisms follows (proof lines 8720). The claim is H2: the topological part is immediate, but the algebraic part is a real argument in which flatness is used through faithful flatness of a local homomorphism to cancel a common factor, and that is the substance of the lemma.
